waive.health: /health (src/health.ts) reports provenance, schema, FTS, bindings and backup freshness, and the deploy's live gate reads it; healthResponse's ping-and-backup shape would drop what the gate checks
waive.explorer:cspReport: the explorer is an assets-only Worker with no code; its CSP reports to Capsid's own /csp-report, which uses receiveCspReport

copies.src/access-sync.ts: normalizeEmail here also validates and returns null for a non-address, so one bad member refuses the whole sync; site-runtime's only lowercases
copies.src/dcr.ts: allowedRedirects here admits only the Google and ChatGPT per-connector callback shapes and logs any other; site-runtime's admits any https callback
copies.src/github/client.ts: readKey here names a KV cache key for a GitHub read, not a frontmatter field
copies.src/read-capped.ts: readCapped here keeps the text read before the cap and says it was truncated (site-runtime's returns null), and imports nothing so the explorer build can load it
copies.src/routine-fire.ts: fireRoutine here is capsid_work_jobs' fire action (seat check, job row, session record); it is not the plain routine POST

libraries.jose: search-console.ts signs the Google service account's JWT and shadow.ts verifies GitHub Actions OIDC tokens; site-runtime's ./access and ./access-login verify only Cloudflare Access tokens
